```{r, load_packages}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r, import_data}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
gs4_deauth()
df <- read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uNYfeghUGPkpMYVwhLSkxx81_x8Syr7t9W8D4Ry4hag/edit?gid=0#gid=0")

# Serialize to JSON for fast, reliable client-side interaction
songs_json <- toJSON(df, dataframe = "rows")
```

## Row {height="18%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox

list(
  icon = "music-note-beamed",
  color = "primary",
  value = nrow(df)
)
```


## Row {height="82%"}

### Column {width="55%"}

::: {.card}
::: {.card-header}
Song List
:::

::: {.card-body}

```{=html}
<div class="cyber-search-wrapper">
  <input 
    type="text" 
    id="searchInput" 
    class="cyber-search-input" 
    placeholder="🔍 Cari judul lagu, anime, atau artis..." 
    oninput="filterSongs()" 
  />
</div>

<div class="cyber-list-container" id="songListContainer">
  <!-- Song items will be rendered by JavaScript -->
</div>
```

### Column {width="45%"}

::: {.card}
::: {.card-header}
Music Player
:::

::: {.card-body}

```{=html}
<div class="player-outer">
  <div class="player-frame-box">
    <iframe 
      id="mainVideoPlayer" 
      src="" 
      title="Music Player" 
      allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" 
      allowfullscreen>
    </iframe>
  </div>

  <div class="now-playing-banner" id="nowPlayingBanner">
    <div class="now-playing-header">
      <span class="now-playing-tag">NOW PLAYING</span>
      <a id="ytExternalLink" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color: #00f2fe; font-size: 0.82rem; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600;">
        YouTube Link ↗
      </a>
    </div>
    <h3 class="now-playing-song-title" id="nowPlayingTitle">-</h3>
    <div class="now-playing-details">
      <span class="badge-anime" id="nowPlayingAnime" style="font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 4px 12px; max-width: none;">-</span>
      <span class="badge-artist" id="nowPlayingArtist" style="font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 4px 12px; max-width: none;">-</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const songs = `r songs_json`;

function getYoutubeId(url) {
  if (!url) return "";
  const match = url.match(/(?:embed\/|v=|vi\/|youtu\.be\/|\/v\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/);
  if (match) return match[1];
  const parts = url.split("?")[0].split("/");
  return parts[parts.length - 1] || "";
}

function getThumb(url) {
  const id = getYoutubeId(url);
  return id ? `https://img.youtube.com/vi/${id}/mqdefault.jpg` : "";
}

let activeIndex = 0;

function playSong(index, shouldAutoplay = true) {
  if (index < 0 || index >= songs.length) return;
  activeIndex = index;
  const song = songs[index];
  
  // Prepare embed URL with autoplay
  let embedUrl = song.link;
  if (shouldAutoplay) {
    const sep = embedUrl.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
    embedUrl = `${embedUrl}${sep}autoplay=1`;
  }
  
  // Update iframe
  const iframe = document.getElementById("mainVideoPlayer");
  if (iframe) {
    iframe.src = embedUrl;
  }
  
  // Update banner info
  const titleEl = document.getElementById("nowPlayingTitle");
  if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = song.Title;
  
  const animeEl = document.getElementById("nowPlayingAnime");
  if (animeEl) animeEl.textContent = "📺 " + song.Anime;
  
  const artistEl = document.getElementById("nowPlayingArtist");
  if (artistEl) artistEl.textContent = "🎤 " + song.Artist;
  
  const extLink = document.getElementById("ytExternalLink");
  if (extLink) {
    const ytWatchUrl = song.link.replace("/embed/", "/watch?v=").split("?")[0];
    extLink.href = ytWatchUrl;
  }
  
  // Update active state and live badge on cards
  document.querySelectorAll(".song-card").forEach(card => {
    const cardIdx = parseInt(card.getAttribute("data-index"), 10);
    const icon = card.querySelector(".play-icon");
    const pill = card.querySelector(".live-pill");
    
    if (cardIdx === index) {
      card.classList.add("active");
      if (icon) icon.textContent = "🔊";
      if (pill) pill.style.display = "inline-block";
    } else {
      card.classList.remove("active");
      if (icon) icon.textContent = "▶";
      if (pill) pill.style.display = "none";
    }
  });
}

function renderSongList(list) {
  const container = document.getElementById("songListContainer");
  if (!container) return;
  
  if (list.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = `
      <div style="text-align: center; padding: 48px 16px; color: #8b95b5;">
        <p style="font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 6px;">❌ Lagu tidak ditemukan</p>
        <span style="font-size: 0.85rem;">Coba cari dengan kata kunci judul, anime, atau artis lain.</span>
      </div>
    `;
    return;
  }
  
  container.innerHTML = list.map(song => {
    const origIndex = songs.findIndex(s => s.Title === song.Title && s.Artist === song.Artist);
    const isSelected = origIndex === activeIndex;
    const thumb = getThumb(song.link);
    return `
      <div class="song-card ${isSelected ? 'active' : ''}" 
           data-index="${origIndex}" 
           onclick="playSong(${origIndex}, true)">
        <div class="song-thumb-wrapper">
          <img class="song-thumb" src="${thumb}" alt="${song.Title}" loading="lazy" />
          <div class="play-badge-overlay">
            <span class="play-icon">${isSelected ? '🔊' : '▶'}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="song-content">
          <div class="song-title-row">
            <span class="song-title">${song.Title}</span>
            <span class="live-pill" style="display: ${isSelected ? 'inline-block' : 'none'};">PLAYING</span>
          </div>
          <div class="song-tags">
            <span class="badge-anime" title="${song.Anime}">📺 ${song.Anime}</span>
            <span class="badge-artist" title="${song.Artist}">🎤 ${song.Artist}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join("");
}

function filterSongs() {
  const query = (document.getElementById("searchInput").value || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  if (!query) {
    renderSongList(songs);
    return;
  }
  const filtered = songs.filter(s => 
    (s.Title && s.Title.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
    (s.Anime && s.Anime.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
    (s.Artist && s.Artist.toLowerCase().includes(query))
  );
  renderSongList(filtered);
}

function initPlayer() {
  if (typeof songs !== 'undefined' && songs.length > 0) {
    renderSongList(songs);
    playSong(0, false); // Load first track into player without forcing audio on page load
  }
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initPlayer);
} else {
  initPlayer();
}
</script>
```
